result:
Here's how I read it: you want fewer empty lanes from no-shows, so that waiting-list members get a swim. Each member with a lane booking gets a text at 18:00 the evening before, unless they ticked "no texts, please."

From the booking app:

- **The club already texts the newsletter** through an SMS provider, so reminders can go out the same way. Nothing sends reminders yet.
- **23% of members have "no texts" ticked.** Under the spec, nearly a quarter of members would get no reminder at all, and that group could be where many of the no-shows come from.
- **Email won't fill that gap well.** 61% of members have no email address on file, so an email fallback would only reach some of them.

Tell me if I've got any of that wrong.

The biggest open question is what should happen for the "no texts" members:

1. **Nothing.** This is the spec as written. It's simplest and fully respects their choice, but it leaves the biggest gap.
2. **An email when they have an address on file, otherwise nothing.** This reaches some of them at little extra cost. I'd pick this one, if "no texts" doesn't also mean "no reminders at all."
3. **Something at booking time**, such as a confirmation that tells them to cancel if they can't make it. This reaches everyone, but it isn't a reminder the evening before.

Which fits what your members meant when they ticked that box?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
